simple.summary: בְּאֵשׁ (bᵉʼêsh) means displease. First listed occurrence: Dan 6 15.

definitions.full: H888. beesh בְּאֵשׁ verb be evil, bad (so ᵑ7 ; Syriac ; Old Aramaic באש Lzb 238 SAC 27 Cooke 191 ; compare Biblical Hebrew); — Pe`al Perfect 3masculine singular impersonal ׳ב עֲלוֺהִי Dan 6:15 i.e. it was evil (displeasing) to him (compare Biblical Hebrew [ רעע ] 1 ).
